observations: I checked the current zoomed-out 02-3.png and page-02.png. Meera matches the sheet: braid over her left shoulder, white-printed blue kurta, white churidar, navy flats, round face with large round eyes. Her bright open smile fits 'relieved, excited'. Because of the zoom-out her face is small on the page, about the face box size, but it can still be identified.

Her hands match the record. Her right hand, with the silver bangle, holds the phone at upper-chest height with the screen toward the reader, and her left hand hangs relaxed at her side. The phone screen shows only a calendar icon and abstract blocks, with no text.

There is a small dark dot on her right cheek. It may be meant as her smile dimple, but it reads like a mole, and a mole under the right eye is the partner's identity trait on vision-cast.png. It is barely visible at page scale and is not a blocker, but it should not be carried into later Meera panels.

The desk next to her holds the open laptop, its screen facing the viewer with blank fields, and an empty office chair, but Ananya, who is seated at the desk in 02-2 and 02-4, is not there. Readers may take it as a different side of the room, so this is a minor continuity observation.
In the composite, the WELBUK CARE label covers the desk and Meera's lower legs but not her face or the phone. The large blank wall above holds her balloon.
